category.name: API clients and testing
category.description: Develop, inspect and automate tests for HTTP and other APIs, with explicit separation between local clients and managed team platforms.
category.audience: Software developers, API QA engineers and technical integration teams
category.audienceRationale: Daily utility for API development and quality assurance roles; narrower than general business collaboration tools.

pricing.note: Solo entry $9/month billed annually; Team $19/user/month annually. Free core client exists; usage/add-ons extra.

oss.name: Bruno
locked: Full Postman Data Export import is Ultimate-only; individual collection import remains available.
Open Source edition has 2 workspaces and 5 OpenAPI syncs/month; paid editions remove these limits.
oss.classificationReason: MIT desktop client and CLI; local operation, not a hosted collaboration server. Paid migration and ordinary workspace/sync capabilities justify C. CLI data-driven execution and reports exist, so GUI edition gates do not imply their total absence.

health.rsx: Authenticated analysis completed; overall 6/10. Repository evidence separately reviewed.

serviceLimitations: Git collaboration uses locally stored collections and a separately operated Git provider; catalog does not claim managed cloud team parity.

oss.classificationReason: MIT self-hosted CE includes workspace member roles and invitations. Enterprise administration/security extras justify B; hosted Cloud Business gates are not assumed to restrict CE.

serviceLimitations: First-party Cloud has separate Free/Business/Enterprise plans; self-host operators supply deployment, upgrades and database operations.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Import individual Postman JSON collections into local Bruno files; complete Data Export import requires Ultimate. Recheck environments, authentication and tests; managed workspaces and monitoring do not transfer as a complete platform.

Bruno accepts Insomnia collection exports in JSON (v4) and YAML (v5+). Review requests, variables and authentication after import; Git-based local collaboration differs from managed organizational controls.

Import Postman collections/environments. Script import is experimental and requires consent; advanced authorization and collection-level settings are omitted. Revalidate tests and authentication. Self-host import limit documented at 50 MB.

Import Insomnia collection/environment JSON. Scripts, tests and advanced authorization do not migrate; regular environment variables supported. Rebuild and test missing workflows; self-host import limit 50 MB.
